ERROR_BEHAVIOR: Outer except attempts one bounded error emit, exits2; failed error emit swallowed => missing evidence and INCOMPLETE
INTERRUPTED_WRITE_BEHAVIOR: No explicit payload exception retry; runtime internal syscall/EINTR resubmissions are not separately bounded by Python-call model
PUBLICATION_CHARGE: Full admitted canonical/raw captured artifact length once, including framing; repeated physical suffix submissions do not add to that logical charge. Every new copy/republication separately charged.
STREAM_RUNTIME_LIMITATION: These source bounds apply to emit, not unqualified interpreter/site/library stdout or stderr. Independent total service stdout/stderr capture cap and exact runtime closure remain required.
ZERO_PROGRESS_BEHAVIOR: n<=0 raises OUTPUT_WRITE; no loop continuation on zero
